summary: Edge Manager labels use Kubernetes key=value syntax (keys and values up to 63 chars, alphanumerics plus -, _, . not at the ends, value optional) and can be set at image build, at enrollment or later; label selectors are comma-separated label lists that select matching devices.
questions: What are the rules for Edge Manager label keys and values?
When can I assign labels to edge devices?
What is a label selector in Edge Manager?
Can a label have no value?
